exposure: Cesarean delivery during second stage of labor
Cesarean delivery during first stage of labor
Stage of labor during primary unplanned cesarean delivery
cohort: Women in their second pregnancy with singleton fetuses, who underwent unplanned cesarean delivery in their first pregnancy and elected trial of labor in their second delivery.
finding: The stage of labor during the primary unplanned cesarean delivery did not affect the likelihood of achieving a subsequent vaginal birth.
